mainEntity.name: What trade-offs should I consider before turning my garage into an apartment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting a garage to an apartment permanently eliminates enclosed vehicle storage and workshop area, which is the primary trade-off homeowners face. In communities across Hillsborough and Pinellas counties, losing a garage can create neighborhood parking challenges or conflict with local rules governing off-street parking minimums. Additionally, water heaters, laundry units, or home storage systems commonly housed in a garage must be relocated or framed into dedicated utility closets. Homeowners must balance this lost storage against the valuable benefit of gaining rental revenue or housing an aging family member.
acceptedAnswer.description: You lose covered parking and bulk storage space, and you must verify that your property still satisfies local off-street parking requirements before removing vehicle stalls.
